commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: Venkatanathacharya who came to the bride's village along with his mother and his kin entered the house which was meant for their stay. The parents of Saraswathi, that virtuous bride who were longing to conduct her marriage were elated when they learnt that the bride groom had arrived at their village. They immediately left for the house where he stayed.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: अथ विवाह-समुत्सुक-कन्यका-गुण-मणी पितरौ निज-मन्दिरात् अगमताम् अभिवीक्षतुम् आदरात् दूरम् उपागतम् आत्म-पुर-उदरम्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: अथ विवाह-समुत्सुक-कन्यका-गुण-मणी पितरौ आत्म-पुर-उदरम् उपागतम् आदरात् अभिवीक्षतुम् निज-मन्दिरात् दूरम् अगमताम् ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Eager for the wedding of their virtuous daughter, the bride's parents respectfully went out a great distance from their home to welcome the bridegroom who had arrived within their town.

2.sa: द्रुतमुपेत्य वरं पितरौ चिरान्मुहुरवेक्ष्य मुदं समवापतुः । पदयुगप्रणतस्य यवीयसोऽस्य चतुरस्य समाशिषमूचतुः ॥ २ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: The parents of the bride who expeditely reached the house where the bridegroom stayed were highly elated when they saw him. When Venkanathacharya, a man of dexterity and perspicacity prostrated at their feet, they blessed him befitting that moment.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: द्रुतम् उपेत्य वरम् पितरौ चिरात् मुहुः अवेक्ष्य मुदम् समवापतुः । पदयुगप्रणतस्य यवीयसः अस्य चतुरस्य समाशिषम् ऊचतुः
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: पितरौ द्रुतम् उपेत्य वरम् चिरात् मुहुः अवेक्ष्य मुदम् समवापतुः पदयुगप्रणतस्य यवीयसः चतुरस्य अस्य समाशिषम् ऊचतुः
commentaries.gemini_summary: The bride's parents quickly approached and were filled with immense joy upon gazing repeatedly at the bridegroom after a long time. As the clever youth bowed at their feet, they bestowed fitting blessings upon him.

3.sa: समसमाः परिषस्वजिरे मुदाऽधिकसमान्पृथुकाः प्रणमन्ति च । बहुवयोभिरिता बहुलाशिषं जगदिरे विविषेष्वपि बन्धुषु ॥ ३ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: Among the near and dear ones who had assembled there, those who were of the same age hugged each other. The younger ones paid their obeisance to the elders. The aged blessed the youngsters who paid their respects to them. Thus everybody felicitated each other with mutual affection and respect befitting their status.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: समसमाः परिषस्वजिरे मुदा अधिकसमान् पृथुकाः प्रणमन्ति च बहुवयोभिः इताः बहुलाशिषम् जगदिरे विविषेषु अपि बन्धुषु
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: बन्धुषु विविषेषु अपि समसमाः मुदा परिषस्वजिरे पृथुकाः च अधिकसमान् प्रणमन्ति बहुवयोभिः इताः बहुलाशिषम् जगदिरे
commentaries.gemini_summary: As the gathered relatives entered, peers joyfully embraced one another, the youngsters bowed down respectfully to their elders, and the elders bestowed abundant blessings upon them.

4.sa: निजगृहोपमनैजनिकेतनं जितविशालपुरं निजसंपदा । अनयतां विनयावनतं वरं ससुहृदं सुहृदा सह दम्पती ॥ ४ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: The parents of the bride took the unpretentious bridegroom and his kin to another house of their own before whose grandeur even the splendour of Ujjain appeared pale.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: निजगृहोपमनैजनिकेतनम् जितविशालपुरम् निजसंपदा अनयताम् विनयावनतम् वरम् ससुहृदम् सुहृदा सह दम्पती
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: दम्पती सुहृदा सह निजसंपदा जितविशालपुरं निजगृहोपमनैजनिकेतनं विनयावनतं ससुहृदं वरम् अनयताम् ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Accompanied by their relatives, the bride's parents led the humble bridegroom and his companions to another opulent mansion of their own, whose grandeur surpassed even the famed city of Ujjayini.

5.sa: बहुविधं परमान्नरसायनं वरनरोभ्यवहृत्य तदाहृतम् । निबिडपट्टवितानकशीतलेप्यहह तुष्टुवुरातपभोजनम् ॥ ५ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: The relatives and the friends of Venkatanathacharya who were seated in the cool shadow of the marriage pandal which had a canopy made of thick cloth of silk and plant fibre, were treated to a sumptuous hot meal constituted with dishes of all the six savours like sweet pudding and many other sweets. The gratified guests contentedly exclaimed "Aahaha" in appreciation of the bride's parents.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: बहुविधम् परमान्न-रसायनम् वर-नरः अभ्यवहृत्य तत्-आहृतम् निबिड-पट्ट-वितानक-शीतले अपि अहह तुष्टुवुः आतप-भोजनम्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: निबिड-पट्ट-वितानक-शीतले अपि वर-नरः तत्-आहृतम् बहुविधम् परमान्न-रसायनम् अभ्यवहृत्य अहह आतप-भोजनम् तुष्टुवुः
commentaries.gemini_summary: Seated in the cool shade of a dense silk canopy, the distinguished guests partook of the diverse delicacies, sweet puddings, and elixirs served to them, exclaiming with delight as they praised the piping-hot feast.

6.sa: अभिदिदृक्षुजने वरमादरादुपगते भवनं तदनुज्ञया । कृतपरस्परसंक्थनो जनः सुखमुवास निशामिह वेश्मनि ॥ ६ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: The people who were eager to see the bridegroom who had come to their Agrahara came to the house where he stayed with the consent of the bride's parents. Then they mutually exchanged pleasantries and greetings with his people and happily spent that night there only.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: अभिदिदृक्षुजने वरम् आदरात् उपगते भवनम् तत्-अनुज्ञया कृत-परस्पर-संक्थनः जनः सुखम् उवास निशाम् इह वेश्मनि
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: अभिदिदृक्षुजने आदरात् वरम् उपगते तदनुज्ञया भवनम् (आगत्य) कृतपरस्परसंक्थनः जनः इह वेश्मनि निशां सुखम् उवास ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: When the people, eager to see the bridegroom, approached him with great respect and entered the house with his permission, they engaged in mutual conversation and spent the night there happily.

7.sa: त्रिदशदेवदिशाधरकंधरे समुदिते नलिनीपरिणेतरि । त्रिपदया सवितारमृचा वरं परिणुवन्तमुपासत सज्जनाः ॥ ७ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: Next day when Venkatanathacharya was paying his obeisance with "Gayatri Mantra" to the Sun god in the course of his Sandhyavandana at dawn when the sun was just rising in the valley of the eastern mountain, all the men of worthiness came near him and recited the hymn of invocation of blessings.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: त्रिदशदेवदिशाधरकन्धरे समुदिते नलिनीपरिणेतरि त्रिपदया सवितारम् ऋचा वरम् परिणुवन्तम् उपासत सज्जनाः
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: त्रिदशदेवदिशाधरकन्धरे नलिनीपरिणेतरि समुदिते (सति) त्रिपदया ऋचा वरं सवितारं परिणुवन्तं (तम्) सज्जनाः उपासत।
commentaries.gemini_summary: As the sun, the beloved of the lotuses, rose over the eastern mountains, virtuous people approached and honored Venkatanatha, who was praising the supreme Sun-god with the three-footed Gayatri mantra.

8.sa: वसनवाहनकुङ्कुमचन्दनै र्विविधरम्यरसैः परिपूज्यतम् । त्वरितमारभताभ्युदयोत्सवं द्विजवरैः पितरौ सह सद्मनि ॥ ८ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: At the time of the ritual of Kashiyatra, the parents of the bride gifted new clothes, vehicles like palanquin, as well as many gold ornaments to the bridegroom. They also respectfully saluted him by offering vermilion, sandal paste, sweet milk and other such sacred drinks. Then they along with other virtuous Brahmins started the prosperous ritual of Ashtavarga at their house.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: वसन-वाहन-कुङ्कुम-चन्दनैः विविध-रम्य-रसैः परिपूज्य तम् त्वरितम् आरभत अभ्युदय-उत्सवम् द्विज-वरैः पितरौ सह सद्मनि
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: पितरौ तम् वसन-वाहन-कुङ्कुम-चन्दनैः विविध-रम्य-रसैः परिपूज्य द्विज-वरैः सह सद्मनि त्वरितम् अभ्युदय-उत्सवम् आरभत ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Having worshipped the bridegroom with garments, conveyances, saffron, sandalwood paste, and various delicious drinks, the bride's parents along with noble Brahmins promptly commenced the festive marriage celebrations at their residence.

9.sa: स्रगन्नवस्तूनि नवग्रहेभ्योप्यनुग्रहार्थं निरवग्रहार्थम् । कुतूहलात्तौ कुलदेवतायै समर्पयामासतुरादरेण ॥ ९ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: The parents of the bride with profound devotion, offered poornaphala (coconut) and other fruits to their family deity and grains like wheat, rice, etc. to Navagrahas (Nine planets) invoking their blessings to get rid off the possible future hindrances for successful conduct of the marriage.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: स्रक्-अन्न-वस्तूनि नवग्रहेभ्यः अपि अनुग्रहार्थम् निरवग्रहार्थम् कुतूहलात् तौ कुलदेवतायै समर्पयामासतुः आदरेण
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: तौ निरवग्रहार्थम् अनुग्रहार्थम् अपि नवग्रहेभ्यः कुलदेवतायै च आदरेण कुतूहलात् स्रगन्नवस्तूनि समर्पयामासतुः ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: To avert all obstacles and secure auspicious blessings, the parents reverently and eagerly offered garlands, grains, and ritual materials to the nine planets and their family deity.

10.sa: विरचय्य तु दीक्षितः प्रयाजं तनुते हन्त यथा प्रधानयागम् । अतनोत्किल कन्यकाप्रदानं मधुपर्कैरभिपूज्य तज्जनस्तम् ॥ १० ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: The bride's father worshipped the bridegroom by respectfully offering honey blent with milk prior to gifting him with the bride in conformity with the procedure as enjoined by the Shastras. All those who were part of the celebrations were highly delighted. It was like the master of a house engaged in deeksha conducting the main yajna after performing the Prayajahoma.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: विरचय्य तु दीक्षितः प्रयाजम् तनुते हन्त यथा प्रधानयागम् अतनोत् किल कन्यकाप्रदानम् मधुपर्कैः अभिपूज्य तत्-जनः तम्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: यथा दीक्षितः प्रयाजं विरचय्य तु प्रधानयागं तनुते, तथा हन्त तज्जनः तम् मधुपर्कैः अभिपूज्य कन्यकाप्रदानम् अतनोत् किल ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Just as a consecrated sacrificer performs the main sacrifice after completing the preliminary Prayāja rites, the bride's father performed the formal giving away of the maiden after properly revering the bridegroom with Madhuparka offerings.

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: Then Venkatarya saw the face of Saraswathi which was blushed coyly as a result of her beholding his moon like face. Saraswathi too whose eyes resembled the blooming lily saw the moon like face of the bridegroom.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: वरमुखेन्दुविलोकनसंकुचल्लपनफुल्लसरोरुहकन्यकाम् अयम् अपश्यत् इयम् च वराननद्विजसखम् ससितोत्पललोचना
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: अयम् वरमुखेन्दुविलोकनसंकुचल्लपनफुल्लसरोरुहकन्यकाम् अपश्यत्, ससितोत्पललोचना इयम् च वराननद्विजसखम् (अपश्यत्)।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Venkatarya looked at the bride, whose lotus-like face bashfully contracted upon seeing the moon of his face; she too, possessing eyes like blooming white lilies, gazed upon the moon-faced bridegroom.

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: A young girl, the functional parts of whose beautiful body resembled the flowers of lotus and Ashoka (Jonesia Ashoka), the arrows of Manmatha; on whose face manifested a broad smile; whose body had the complexion of gold, exhibited her extreme gladness when she saw many virtuous married women coming to attend the wedding. Then she herself came forward and honoured those women by offering vermilion, turmeric, sandal paste, flowers, betel leaves and nuts to them.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: इन्दुवदन-आकलित-मन्द-हसनानाम् कुन्द-रदन-आहसित-हंस-गमनानाम् कन्दुक-समाकृति-पयोधर-युगानाम् कन्तु-निज-जङ्गम-जय-ध्वज-लतानाम्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: इन्दुवदनाकलितमन्दहसनानाम् कुन्दरदनाहसितहंसगमनानाम् कन्दुकसमाकृतिपयोधरयुगानाम् कन्तुनिजजङ्गमजयध्वजलतानाम् (स्त्रीणाम् रूपं व्यराजत)।
commentaries.gemini_summary: This verse describes the exquisite beauty of the women, highlighting their gentle smiles on moon-like faces, jasmine-like teeth, gait outshining swans, rounded ball-like breasts, and slender forms resembling moving victory-banners of Kamadeva (Cupid).

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: Another girl whose face had the shine of moon saw some beautiful women coming there walking slowly. She came forward and honoured those women with sandalpaste and flowers. Yet another girl whose teeth resembled the jasmine buds voluntarily came forward to pay honours with turmeric, vermilion, sandalpaste etc. to many girls whose plumpy bosoms were like round balls; who looked like the moving victory flag of Manmatha; and whose grace in and pace of walking put even the swan to shame.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: आगत्य द्रुतम् अबला-प्रहर्षणी का अपि आलोक्य आगमनम् अनङ्ग-सायक-अङ्गी नारीणाम् उचिततर-अङ्गराग-पुष्पैः आनर्च स्मित-लपना अतिरोहितासु
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: का अपि अनङ्गसायकाङ्गी स्मितलपना अबलाप्रहर्षणी नारीणाम् आगमनम् आलोक्य द्रुतम् आगत्य उचिततराङ्गरागपुष्पैः अतिरोहितासु आनर्च ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Upon seeing the arrival of the women, a beautiful smiling maiden with limbs like Cupid's arrows swiftly came forward to welcome and honor them with fragrant body ointments and flowers.

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: When those beautiful girls who had assembled there started singing melodiously with their sweet and mellifluent voices which put even the voices of the peacock, the parrot, the humble bee, the kinnara women and the cuckoo to shame, the priyala trees (Bhuchanania latifolia) strewed flowers all over the courtyard outside the marriage hall. Those who saw those flowers felt as though the devatas themselves who had descended on the earth to have a look at the bride and the groom must have showered them.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: जित-नीलकण्ठ-शुक-मञ्जुभाषिणी-परपुष्ट-सद्-युवति-गीत-गीतितः सदन-प्रियाल-कुसुम-आलयः वधू-वर-वीक्षण-आगत-सुर-अर्पिताः इव
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: जित-नीलकण्ठ-शुक-मञ्जुभाषिणी-परपुष्ट-सद्-युवति-गीत-गीतितः सदन-प्रियाल-कुसुम-आलयः वधू-वर-वीक्षण-आगत-सुर-अर्पिताः इव (अभवत्)।
commentaries.gemini_summary: As charming young maidens whose sweet voices surpassed those of peacocks, parrots, and cuckoos sang melodiously, the abundance of priyāla blossoms strewn about the house looked like flowers showered by the gods who had descended to witness the bride and the bridegroom.

15.sa: प्रमिताक्षरामुचमनूद्य सुहृत्समुपाहृतान्यभिनवानि मुहुः । विविधानि पुरोहितजनावनयो र्वसनानि संसदि समर्पयताम् ॥ १५ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: Chanting short verses from the Vedas, the family priests of the bride and the groom handed over to the couple gifts like new clothes, etc. which were brought for them by their near and dear ones.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: प्रमिताक्षराम् ऋचम् अनूद्य सुहृत्-समुपाहृतानि अभिनवानि मुहुः विविधानि पुरोहितजनौ अनयोः वसनानि संसदि समर्पयताम्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: पुरोहितजनौ प्रमिताक्षराम् ऋचम् अनूद्य संसदि सुहृत्-समुपाहृतानि अभिनवानि विविधानि वसनानि मुहुः अनयोः समर्पयताम् ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Reciting concise Vedic verses, the family priests presented the various new garments brought by friends and relatives to the bride and groom in the assembly.

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: Two pious women holding a silver platter on which were placed two silver lamps which had the dazzle of Shukra and Guru rotating constantly as a result of the momentum caused by the churning of the ocean of milk, came near the newly married couple, and waved the platter and the lamps around that couple rapidly first and then slowly.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: मथन-संस्कृति-संतत-संभ्रमत्-सित-गुरु-उज्ज्वल-दीपक-भाजनम् अनयतः स्म वधू-वर-सन्मुखम् द्रुत-विलम्बितम् एत्य वर-अङ्गने
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: वराङ्गने एत्य मथनसंस्कृतिसंततसंभ्रमत्सितगुरूज्ज्वलदीपकभाजनम् वधूवरसन्मुखम् द्रुतविलम्बितम् अनयतः स्म ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Two auspicious ladies approached the newly married couple and performed the mangalarati, waving before them alternately quickly and slowly a platter bearing brilliant lamps that shone like the bright planets Venus and Jupiter.

17.sa: नानाविद्याशालिनीवृद्घिभाजां भूदेवानां भूषणै राजमाना । वेदानुच्चैरुच्चरन्ती किरन्ती दम्पत्योरित्याशिषः संसदूचे ॥ १७ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: Loudly chanting Vedic hymns, the aged scholarly Brahmins who were adorned with new clothes as well as ornaments like earrings and rings showered consecrated rice on the heads of the couple and blessed them with words like....
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: नानाविद्याशालिनी वृद्धिभाजां भूदेवानां भूषणैः राजमाना वेदान् उच्चैः उच्चरन्ती किरन्ती दम्पत्योः इति आशिषः संसद् ऊचे
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: नानाविद्याशालिनी वृद्धिभाजां भूदेवानां भूषणैः राजमाना वेदान् उच्चैः उच्चरन्ती किरन्ती संसद् दम्पत्योः इति आशिषः ऊचे
commentaries.gemini_summary: Resplendent with the adornments of wise and elderly Brahmins, the scholarly assembly loudly chanted the Vedas, showered consecrated grains upon the couple, and pronounced auspicious blessings upon them.

18.sa: बालावैतावाप्नुतां दीर्घमायुर्नित्यां प्रीतिं चाष्टपुत्रान्गुणाढ्यान् । शस्तं वित्तं संततिं शोभमानां सौख्यं धन्यौ धान्यभूगोसमृद्धिम् ॥ १८ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: "Let this couple live long, let them have unhindered love and affection for each other, let them beget eight virtuous sons, let them earn sufficient wealth in a just and fair manner, let them beget children and grandchildren bestowed with constant fame and repute, let them always remain happy, let them plentifully get wealth in the form of grains, lands and estates and cows, let them become blest and righteous". It was thus those aged Brahmins blessed the couple.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: बालौ एतौ आप्नुताम् दीर्घम् आयुः नित्याम् प्रीतिम् च अष्टपुत्रान् गुणाढ्यान् शस्तम् वित्तम् संततिम् शोभमानाम् सौख्यम् धन्यौ धान्यभूगोसमृद्धिम्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: धन्यौ एतौ बालौ दीर्घम् आयुः नित्याम् प्रीतिम् च गुणाढ्यान् अष्टपुत्रान् शस्तम् वित्तम् शोभमानाम् संततिम् सौख्यम् धान्यभूगोसमृद्धिम् आप्नुताम् ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: May this blessed young couple obtain a long life, everlasting mutual affection, eight virtuous sons, righteous wealth, a thriving lineage, happiness, and an abundance of grain, land, and cattle.

19.sa: इन्द्राणी बलरिपुवैरिणीव वाणी लोकेशे कलशपयोधिन्यकेव । गोविन्दे गरलगले गिरीन्द्रकन्या कन्या स्याद्दयितमनःप्रहर्षणीयम् ॥ १९ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: "Let this bride always bring happiness to her sweetheart like Shachidevi does to Devendra who hates 'Bala' his enemy; Saraswathi does to Brahma the master of this mankind; Lakshmidevi who emerged from the ocean of milk does to Lord Sri Govinda; and Parvathi, the daughter of Himaraja, the king of mountains does to Shiva who holds poison in his throat". Thus those aged Brahmins blessed the bride too.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: इन्द्राणी बलरिपुवैरिणि इव वाणी लोकेशे कलशपयोधिकन्यका इव गोविन्दे गरलगले गिरीन्द्रकन्या कन्या स्यात् दयितमनःप्रहर्षणी इयम्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: बलरिपुवैरिणि इन्द्राणी इव लोकेशे वाणी इव गोविन्दे कलशपयोधिकन्यका इव गरलगले गिरीन्द्रकन्या इव इयं कन्या दयितमनःप्रहर्षणी स्यात् ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: May this bride bring immense joy to her beloved husband's heart, just as Indrani delights Indra, Sarasvati delights Brahma, Lakshmi delights Govinda, and Parvati delights Shiva.

20.sa: नत्वा हरिं गुरुमनन्तरमार्यनारीसेवारतावसितवारिजलोचनाभिः । दृष्टौ वसन्ततिलकाविव तावभातां तत्रान्तरे सुकुतुकं सुमनःपरीतौ ॥ २० ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: The newly married couple paid their obeisance to Lord Sri Hari and Guru. Then they engaged themselves in extending their regardful hospitality to the elder Brahmins and women. When they stood there being curiously watched by those beautiful women whose eyes resembled the blue lily flower, they appeared splendid like two tilak trees (a species of tree with beautiful flowers) covered with beautiful flowers during the spring.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: नत्वा हरिम् गुरुम् अनन्तरम् आर्य-नारी-सेवा-रतौ असित-वारिज-लोचनाभिः दृष्टौ वसन्त-तिलकौ इव तौ अभाताम् तत्र-अन्तरे सुकुतुकम् सुमनः-परीतौ
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: अनन्तरम् हरिम् गुरुम् नत्वा आर्य-नारी-सेवा-रतौ तौ तत्र-अन्तरे असित-वारिज-लोचनाभिः सुकुतुकम् दृष्टौ सुमनः-परीतौ वसन्त-तिलकौ इव अभाताम् ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: After bowing to Lord Hari and the preceptors, the newlyweds devoted themselves to honoring the elder women. Surrounded by flowers and eagerly gazed upon by ladies with dark, lotus-like eyes, the couple shone like blossoming Tilaka trees in the spring season.

21.sa: नियुज्य वंशस्थनितम्बिनीवधूपिता वरीयार्यजनार्चनाकृते । वधूवरौ वारिजलोचनाभुभौ परस्परं भोजयितुं प्रचक्रमे ॥ २१ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: Many people who were related to the bride had come to attend the marriage. After the conclusion of all the rituals with regard to the marriage, the bride's father assigned the work of serving them food to some women who were born in noble families and who were well versed with customs and traditions. The bride and the groom whose eyes were as beautiful as lotus were shining with comeliness amongst these people. The bride's father himself came forward to assist the couple in having their food in a ritual known as 'Bhooma' when the couple relish their food from the same plantain leaf or silver plate.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: नियुज्य वंशस्थ-नितम्बिनीः वधू-पिता वरीयान् आर्य-जन-अर्चना-कृते वधू-वरौ वारिज-लोचनौ उभौ परस्परम् भोजयितुम् प्रचक्रमे
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: वरीयान् वधूपिता आर्यजनार्चनाकृते वंशस्थनितम्बिनीः नियुज्य वारिजलोचनौ उभौ वधूवरौ परस्परं भोजयितुं प्रचक्रमे।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Having appointed noble ladies to honour and serve the distinguished guests, the bride's father personally began the ceremony of having the lotus-eyed bride and groom feed each other.

22.sa: भूदेवान्मोजयित्वा तदनु तदुचितैरम्बरैर्दक्षिणाभि- स्ताम्बूलैस्तोषयित्वा विरचितनियमक्षीणहान्येवमेषः । विद्वत्सङ्घं निकामं विनयमुखगुणैर्नन्दयन्वेङ्कटार्यो दीक्षां प्राप्येव यज्वातदनु निशि मुदा शेषहोमं व्यतानीत् ॥ २२ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: The marriage celebrations of Sri Venkatarya lasted for three days. All the Brahmins were contented with sumptuous feast arranged on the occasion. Sri Venkatarya delighted those Brahmins by offering gifts in the form of clothes, money (dakshina) along with betel leaves and nuts befitting their stature. The scholars who were present there were highly impressed with the witty intellect, humility and magnanimity exhibited by Venkatarya. He finished Seshahoma after midnight on the fourth day like a performer of yaga engaged in deeksha does.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: भूदेवान् भोजयित्वा तदनु तत्-उचितैः अम्बरैः दक्षिणाभिः ताम्बूलैः तोषयित्वा विरचित-नियम-क्षीण-हानिः एवम् एषः विद्वत्-सङ्घम् निकामम् विनय-मुख-गुणैः नन्दयन् वेङ्कटार्यः दीक्षाम् प्राप्य इव यज्वा तदनु निशि मुदा शेष-होमम् व्यतानीत्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: एवम् एषः वेङ्कटार्यः भूदेवान् भोजयित्वा तदनु तत्-उचितैः अम्बरैः दक्षिणाभिः ताम्बूलैः तोषयित्वा विनय-मुख-गुणैः विद्वत्-सङ्घम् निकामम् नन्दयन् विरचित-नियम-क्षीण-हानिः सन् दीक्षां प्राप्य यज्वा इव तदनु निशि मुदा शेष-होमं व्यतानीत्
commentaries.gemini_summary: After sumptuously feeding the Brahmins, gratifying them with suitable garments, gifts, and betel rolls, and delighting the assembly of scholars with his humility and noble qualities, Venkatarya, having duly observed the required marriage vows to ward off all obstacles, joyfully performed the concluding Shesha-homa ritual at night like a consecrated sacrificer.

23.sa: आगच्छन्पथि वध्वा साकं सर्वैः समं निजग्रामम् । काननभूषु वधूनां दोहललक्ष्मीरपश्यदुरुमेधाः ॥ २३ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: Thus after the successful conclusion of his marriage celebrations, Sri Venkatarya, a man of great intellect left for his place accompanied by his wife and the kin. On his way back, he interestingly watched some women who were accompanying them engage themselves in Dohalotsava in a garden.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: आगच्छन् पथि वध्वा साकम् सर्वैः समम् निज-ग्रामम् कानन-भूषु वधूनाम् दोहल-लक्ष्मीः अपश्यत् उरु-मेधाः
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: उरु-मेधाः वध्वा साकम् सर्वैः समम् निज-ग्रामम् पथि आगच्छन् कानन-भूषु वधूनाम् दोहल-लक्ष्मीः अपश्यत् ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: As the highly intelligent Venkatanatha was travelling back to his village along the road with his new bride and all his relatives, he observed the delightful dohala rites performed by young women in the forest clearings.

24.sa: चकितहरिणशावकेक्षणस्त्रीचरणहतोपि पुनः पुनर्यदीयः । ननु हसितरामशोकशाखी प्रकटयितुं नितरामशोकभावम् ॥ २४ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: There were many jungles which were full of Ashoka (jonesia asoka) trees on the return route of Sri Venkatarya. A beautiful girl whose eyes resembled those of a frightened calf of a deer kicked one of those trees. But that tree did not ventilate its grief. It remained smiling continuously even when it was being repeatedly kicked probably to justify its appellation which meant one without grief. Those who saw flowers in abundance adorning the tree felt as though it was smiling (there is a belief that Ashoka tree yields flowers when it is kicked by beautiful women).
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: चकित-हरिण-शावक-ईक्षण-स्त्री-चरण-हतः अपि पुनः पुनः यदीयः ननु हसितराम् अशोक-शाखी प्रकटयितुम् नितराम् अशोक-भावम्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: यदीयः अशोक-शाखी चकित-हरिण-शावक-ईक्षण-स्त्री-चरण-हतः अपि नितराम् अशोक-भावम् प्रकटयितुम् पुनः पुनः हसितराम् ननु ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Even when kicked repeatedly by the foot of a maiden whose eyes resembled a startled fawn's, the Ashoka tree of that forest blossomed intensely as if smiling, as though to demonstrate its true sorrowless (ashoka) nature.

25.sa: कुरबकविटपे कृशेशयाक्ष्याः कुचयुगलस्तबकेन कोमलाङ्ग्याः । किमुकृत समवायिना वसन्तस्तबककुलानि तदाकृतीनि यस्मिन् ॥ २५ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: There is a belief that the tree of Amaranth yields flowers when beautiful women embrace it according to Dohashastra which is also confirmed by the opinion of the poets. The poet, with this belief in mind, has described that when a beautiful woman with lotus like eyes embraced the Amaranth tree, bunches of flowers in the shape of the bosom of a girl covered the entire tree. It appeared as though that the spring (Vasantha) must have skilfully created those bunches of flowers in plenty in the shape of the bosoms of that beautiful girl who embraced the tree.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: कुरबकविटपे कृशेशयाक्ष्याः कुच-युगल-स्तबकेन कोमलाङ्ग्याः किमु अकृत समवायिना वसन्तः स्तबक-कुलानि तत्-आकृतीनि यस्मिन्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: यस्मिन् कुरबकविटपे समवायिना कोमलाङ्ग्याः कृशेशयाक्ष्याः कुचयुगलस्तबकेन वसन्तः तदाकृतीनि स्तबककुलानि किमु अकृत।
commentaries.gemini_summary: When a delicate, lotus-eyed maiden embraced the Kurabaka tree, it blossomed with numerous flower clusters shaped like her breasts, making it appear as though Spring itself had crafted them after that form.

26.sa: बकुलतरुरवाप्य वारिजाक्ष्या मुखरससेवनमुन्नतोऽबलायाः । प्रतिकृतिमकृतेव पक्ष्मलाक्ष्याः प्रसवपरंपरया तदङ्गभाजा ॥ २६ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: Keeping in mind the belief that the Bakula (Nagakesari - Mimusops elengi) tree yields flowers when a beautiful girl puts some vinous drink in her mouth, rinses and sprinkles it on that tree, the poet has given this description. There were number of Bakula trees along the route through which Venkatanathacharya and his wife were passing. When a beautiful girl from their group sprinkled some vinous drink on one of the trees from her mouth, flowers in large numbers instantaneously appeared on its branches. For an onlooker, it looked like the image of that beautiful girl who too was decorated with flowers.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: बकुलतरुः अवाप्य वारिजाक्ष्याः मुखरससेवनम् उन्नतः अबलायाः प्रतिकृतिम् अकृत इव पक्ष्मलाक्ष्याः प्रसवपरंपरया तदङ्गभाजा
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: उन्नतः बकुलतरुः वारिजाक्ष्याः अबलायाः मुखरससेवनम् अवाप्य तदङ्गभाजा प्रसवपरंपरया पक्ष्मलाक्ष्याः प्रतिकृतिम् अकृत इव ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Upon receiving the spray of wine from the mouth of a lotus-eyed damsel, the tall Bakula tree bloomed profusely all over its limbs, as though creating a floral likeness of the beautiful-eyed maiden herself.

27.sa: कुवलयदलनीललोचनाभिस्तिलकतरुष्ववलोकितेषु नूनम् । प्रतिफलितविलोचनानि नो चेत्समरुचिभाञ्जि कथं सुमानि तेषाम् ॥ २७ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: When those beautiful girls who had eyes like blue lily, set their eyes on tilak tree (a species of trees with beautiful flowers) which were abundantly present all along their way, those trees started sparkling yielding thousands of flowers. But the men of passion thought that they were not flowers but the images of the eyes of those beautiful girls permeating the entire tree. If they were flowers, why did they appear like the beautiful black eyes of those pretty girls?
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: कुवलय-दल-नील-लोचनाभिः तिलक-तरुषु अवलोकितेषु नूनम् प्रतिफलित-विलोचनानि नो चेत् सम-रुचि-भाञ्जि कथम् सुमानि तेषाम्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: कुवलयदलनीललोचनाभिः तिलकतरुषु अवलोकितेषु नूनं तेषां सुमानि प्रतिफलितविलोचनानि (अभूवन्), नो चेत् तेषां सुमानि समरुचिभाञ्जि कथम् (अभवन्)?
commentaries.gemini_summary: When women with eyes as dark as blue lotus petals glanced at the tilaka trees, their blossoms appeared to be reflections of those eyes; otherwise, how else could the flowers have possessed the exact same dark and lovely radiance?

28.sa: परिहसनपराः पयोरुहाक्ष्यः सुमकपटेन हसन्तमाबबन्धुः । व्रततिततिभिरञ्जना नमेरुं परिहसतीति विलोक्य किं मदीयम् ॥ २८ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: When those pretty girls with lotus like eyes were smiling while walking in the jungle, they saw a Nameru (the Alexandrian laurel) tree with full of flowers. They mistook those flowers as the smile of the tree. Misapprehending that the tree must be imitating them, they got enraged and tied it up with creepers.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: परिहसनपराः पयोरुहाक्ष्यः सुमकपटेन हसन्तम् आबबन्धुः व्रततिततिभिः अञ्जनाः नमेरुम् परिहसति इति विलोक्य किम् मदीयम्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: परिहसनपराः पयोरुहाक्ष्यः अञ्जनाः 'किम् मदीयं परिहसति' इति विलोक्य सुमकपटेन हसन्तं नमेरुं व्रततिततिभिः आबबन्धुः।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Fond of teasing and jest, the lotus-eyed women imagined that the blooming Nameru tree was laughing at them under the guise of its flowers, and playfully tied it up with strands of creepers.

29.sa: करपरिमलनात्कुशेशयाक्ष्याः प्रतिविटपं विकचप्रसूनशाली । सभयमभिनिरीक्षितावकाशो व्यपगतनिद्र इवास यत्र चूतः ॥ २९ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: The mango tree started shining elegantly even with its smallest branch covered with flowers, by the mere touch of those beautiful girls who had lotus like eyes. When those girls set their sights on those branches which had no flowers, the tree looked like on gazing astonishingly frightened after getting up from his sleep.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: करपरिमलनात् कुशेशयाक्ष्याः प्रतिविटपम् विकचप्रसूनशाली सभयम् अभिनिरीक्षितावकाशः व्यपगतनिद्रः इव आस यत्र चूतः
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: यत्र कुशेशयाक्ष्याः करपरिमलनात् प्रतिविटपम् विकचप्रसूनशाली चूतः सभयम् अभिनिरीक्षितावकाशः व्यपगतनिद्रः इव आस ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: In that land, upon being touched by the hands of lotus-eyed maidens, the mango tree bloomed across every branch, looking like a person freshly awoken from sleep who nervously gazes all around.

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: When those beautiful girls set their sights on the tilak tree, it yielded flowers in abundance so much so that those flowers covered the entire tree. One who saw those flowers felt as though that the tree must have gained thousands of eyes to take pleasure in beholding the loveliness of the bodies of those girls whose black eyes resembled the petals of lily.

31.sa: शुकपिककलकण्ठकिन्नरस्त्रीस्मयहरविस्मयगानमानताङ्ग्याः । सकुतुकमुपकर्ण्य संमुदेन प्रसवकुलं प्रववर्ष किं प्रियालः ॥ ३१ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: Those girls who had beautiful eyes and slightly curved bodies sang astonishingly so as to destroy the pride of the parrot, the cuckoo, the pigeon and the kinnara women. The Priyala (Bhuchanania latifolia) tree which became oblivious of its surroundings in the melody of their music yielded flowers in abundance and showered those flowers on the girls. It appeared as though that the tree yielded flowers only to shower those flower on the girls.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: शुक-पिक-कलकण्ठ-किन्नरस्त्री-स्मय-हर-विस्मय-गानम् आनताङ्ग्याः सकुतुकम् उपकर्ण्य संमुदेन प्रसव-कुलम् प्रववर्ष किम् प्रियालः
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: आनताङ्ग्याः शुक-पिक-कलकण्ठ-किन्नरस्त्री-स्मय-हर-विस्मय-गानम् सकुतुकम् उपकर्ण्य प्रियालः संमुदेन प्रसव-कुलम् प्रववर्ष किम् ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Upon eagerly listening to the wondrous singing of the slender-bodied damsel, which destroyed the pride of parrots, cuckoos, pigeons, and Kinnara women, the Priyala tree showered a profusion of blossoms as if overcome with delight.

32.sa: अशोकवृक्षाः कमलेक्षणानां मनोज्ञपादांबुजताडनेन । उल्लासमापुस्सहसा तदानीं यथैव लीलाकमलैर्युवानः ॥ ३२ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: When beautiful girls amusingly hit their sweethearts with lotus, they experience a feeling of exhilaration of their spirits. Likewise, when those girls with lotus like eyes smilingly struck and kicked the Ashoka trees, those trees too were extremely exulted.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: अशोकवृक्षाः कमलेक्षणानाम् मनोज्ञ-पाद-अम्बुज-ताडनेन उल्लासम् आपुः सहसा तदानीम् यथा एव लीला-कमलैः युवानः
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: तदानीम् कमलेक्षणानाम् मनोज्ञ-पाद-अम्बुज-ताडनेन अशोकवृक्षाः सहसा उल्लासम् आपुः, यथा एव लीला-कमलैः युवानः (उल्लासम् आपुः)।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Just as young lovers experience delight when playfully struck with lotuses by beautiful women, the Ashoka trees instantly bloomed with joy upon being kicked by the charming lotus feet of the lotus-eyed maidens.

33.sa: भुजालताभिस्तरुणीजनानां मदान्वितानां परिरम्भणेन । अगाद्विकासं कुरवोपि पश्चान्नदद् द्विरेफैः सुरवो बभूव ॥ ३३ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: When those charming girls who were intoxicated by their juvenility happily embraced the henna trees with their creeper like arms, those trees began to look splendid with abundant beautiful flowers. Though those trees had hoarse voices initially, that hoarseness turned mellifluous when the buzzing bees which were attracted by the flowers started to fly around them.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: भुजालताभिः तरुणीजनानाम् मद-अन्वितानाम् परिरम्भणेन अगात् विकासम् कुरवः अपि पश्चात् नदत्-द्विरेफैः सुरवः बभूव
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: मदान्वितानाम् तरुणीजनानाम् भुजालताभिः परिरम्भणेन कुरवः अपि विकासम् अगात् पश्चात् नदद्-द्विरेफैः सुरवः बभूव
commentaries.gemini_summary: Embraced by the creeper-like arms of the impassioned young maidens, the Kuravaka trees burst into full bloom and subsequently became sweet-sounding through the hum of hovering bees.

34.sa: चन्द्राननानां शफरेक्षणानां कुम्भस्तनीनां कुटिलालकानाम् । विलासिनीनां द्युतिमाललम्बे गण्डूषशीधोर्बकुलोवसेकात् ॥ ३४ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: The moment those pretty girls whose faces shone like moon, long coquettish eyes gleamed like fish, plumpy bosoms put the pot to shame, and who had their hairs twisted into ringlets, put some vinous drink into their mouths, rinsed and sprinkled it on Bakula (Nagakesara) trees, those trees started to yield flowers in large numbers and looked splendid covered by those flowers.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: चन्द्राननानाम् शफरेक्षणानाम् कुम्भस्तनीनाम् कुटिलालकानाम् विलासिनीनाम् द्युतिम् आललम्बे गण्डूष-शीधोः बकुलः अवसेकात्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: चन्द्राननानां शफरेक्षणानां कुम्भस्तनीनां कुटिलालकानां विलासिनीनां गण्डूष-शीधोः अवसेकात् बकुलः द्युतिम् आललम्बे ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Upon being sprinkled with mouthfuls of wine by charming women possessed of moon-like faces, fish-shaped eyes, pitcher-like breasts, and curly hair, the Bakula tree blossomed and took on magnificent beauty.

35.sa: आलोकनादायतलोचनानां मदोद्धतानां प्रकटानुरागम् । दधार शोभां तिलकद्रुमाणां पाली सभृङ्गैस्तबकैस्तदानीम् ॥ ३५ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: When those beautiful girls who had large eyes and who were intoxicated by their juvenility passionately set their oblique sights on the rows of tilak trees, the entire rows of trees looked comely being instantaneously adorned with plenteous bunches of flowers which were surrounded by thousands of buzzing bees.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: आलोकनात् आयतलोचनानाम् मदोद्धतानाम् प्रकटानुरागम् दधार शोभाम् तिलकद्रुमाणाम् पाली सभृङ्गैः स्तबकैः तदानीम्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: तदानीम् मदोद्धतानाम् आयतलोचनानाम् आलोकनात् तिलकद्रुमाणाम् पाली प्रकटानुरागम् सभृङ्गैः स्तबकैः शोभाम् दधार ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Upon being glanced at with evident affection by the youthful, large-eyed women, the row of Tilaka trees bloomed and attained great splendor with clusters of flowers buzzing with bees.

36.sa: गीत्या महत्या कलकण्ठकण्ठ्या विकासमाधत्त तदा प्रियालः । तन्मञ्जरीषट्चरणादिगीत्या वियोगिनीचित्तमिदं विषादम् ॥ ३६ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: When a beautiful girl rendered a melodious song with her sweet voice, the priyala tree which was fascinated by the mellifluence of that voice blossomed with full of flowers. But when thousands of buzzing bees surrounded those bunches of flowers, those trees became melancholic as they could not put up with the din caused by constant whizz of those bees. This is really astonishing!
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: गीत्या महत्या कलकण्ठकण्ठ्या विकासम् आधत्त तदा प्रियालः तन्मञ्जरी-षट्चरण-आदि-गीत्या वियोगिनी-चित्तम् इदम् विषादम्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: तदा कलकण्ठकण्ठ्या महत्या गीत्या प्रियालः विकासम् आधत्त तन्मञ्जरी-षट्चरण-आदि-गीत्या इदम् वियोगिनीचित्तम् विषादम् (आधत्त)
commentaries.gemini_summary: At that time, the Priyāla tree blossomed upon hearing the sweet, melodious song of the cuckoo, while the buzzing of bees swarming over those blossoms plunged the heart of the separated woman into deep grief.

37.sa: पद्माननानां वदनानिलेन श्रियं विवव्रे खलु सिन्धुवारः । बाहालतास्पर्शनतो रसालस्तदाङ्कुरैः कण्टकितो व्यलासीत् ॥ ३७ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: The Sindhuvara tree (Vitex negundo) looked splendid with yield of flowers in large numbers, just when those charming girls with lotus like faces blew air at it through their mouths. On the other hand, when those pretty girls embraced the mango tree with their creeper like arms, it appeared beautiful when it yielded sprouts of flowers.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: पद्माननानाम् वदनानिलेन श्रियम् विवव्रे खलु सिन्धुवारः बाहालतास्पर्शनतः रसालः तदाङ्कुरैः कण्टकितः व्यलासीत्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: सिन्धुवारः पद्माननानां वदनानिलेन श्रियं विवव्रे खलु । रसालः बाहालतास्पर्शनतः तदाङ्कुरैः कण्टकितः व्यलासीत् ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: The Sindhuvara tree blossomed with beauty upon receiving the breath of the lotus-faced maidens, while the mango tree shone as if horripilating with fresh sprouts from the touch of their creeper-like arms.

38.sa: वार्ताविशेषैर्वनजेक्षणानां पिकप्रियानिःस्वनलालनीयैः । उदङ्कुरोभूदथ कर्णिकारो रागश्च यूनां हृदये तदानीम् ॥ ३८ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: The Karnickara (red water-lily) tree shone splendidly with sprouts of flowers when it heard those women with lotus like eyes talking passionately with sweet voices which resembled the mellifluous voice of the female cuckoo. It was then that the hearts of young boys too experienced impassionate feelings of love.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: वार्ताविशेषैः वनजेक्षणानाम् पिकप्रियानिःस्वनलालनीयैः उदङ्कुरः अभूत् अथ कर्णिकारः रागः च यूनाम् हृदये तदानीम्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: अथ पिकप्रियानिःस्वनलालनीयैः वनजेक्षणानाम् वार्ताविशेषैः कर्णिकारः उदङ्कुरः अभूत्, तदानीम् यूनाम् हृदये रागः च अभूत् ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Upon hearing the charming conversations of lotus-eyed maidens, which were as sweet as the cooing of female cuckoos, the Karṇikāra tree burst into new sprouts, and simultaneously passionate love sprouted in the hearts of the youth.

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: It is surprising that as soon as those pretty girls sprayed the reddish spittle of the chewed pungent and aromatic blend of betel leaf and its ingredients like betel nut, spices and caustic lime on the champak tree, it too turned red and shone splendidly with new shoots of leaves!
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: मुखानुरागात् महिलाजनानाम् चाम्पेयशाखी नवपल्लवौघैः समुत्थितैः तत्क्षणजातशोभैः तदा अनुरागी समभूत् विचित्रम्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: महिलाजनानाम् मुखानुरागात् तदा समुत्थितैः तत्क्षणजातशोभैः नवपल्लवौघैः चाम्पेयशाखी अनुरागी समभूत् (इति) विचित्रम्
commentaries.gemini_summary: It was wonderful that upon receiving the red betel-tinted breath/spray from the women's mouths, the Champaka tree instantly became red with passion, blossoming with fresh clusters of newly emerged, splendid shoots.

40.sa: यासां नमेरुः कुचगौरवेण तुलायितो नाजनि हासपात्रम् । नकारयुक्तत्पदवाच्यभूरुहो जहास हासैः कुसुमैश्च तासाम् ॥ ४० ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: When some people compared the heavy plumpy bosoms of those beautiful girls to Meruparvata, the latter became a target for derision. When some other people said that as those bosoms are weightier than Meruparvata, they cannot be compared with the latter, then also it became a target for ironical contempt. Those girls too laughed at it sarcastically. Incited by their sarcastic laugh, its enemy Nameru tree (Alaxandrian laurel) too appeared to laugh on the pretext of yielding flowers.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: यासाम् न मेरुः कुच-गौरवेण तुलायितः न अजनि हास-पात्रम् नकार-युक्त-तत्-पद-वाच्य-भूरुहः जहास हासैः कुसुमैः च तासाम्
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: यासाम् कुचगौरवेण तुलायितः मेरुः हासपात्रम् न न अजनि नकारयुक्ततत्पदवाच्यभूरुहः तासाम् हासैः कुसुमैः च जहास
commentaries.gemini_summary: When compared to the heavy breasts of the celestial women, Mount Meru became an object of mockery, and the Nameru tree (the tree named by prefixing 'na' to 'Meru') seemed to mockingly laugh along with their smiles through its blooming flowers.

41.sa: षडङ्घ्रिसंघारवकैतवेन गायन्मुदा माधवकीर्तिमुच्चैः । द्विजप्रवेकैर्यरुचत्प्रवीतः शुको यथा तत्र हि किंशुकद्रुः ॥ ४१ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: The sage Shukacharya while singing and reading the Vedas along with Vedangas explains their meaning to the virtuous Brahmins sitting around him so that they clearly apprehend everything about the greatness of Lord Sri Lakshminarayana, the consort of Goddess Lakshmi. Likewise the parrot surrounded by many birds sings the significance of the spring and the month of Vaishakha in a voice more audible than that of the bees. Similarly it appeared as though that the Kimshuka (Butea frondosa) tree itself sang the greatness of Vasantha Madhava and Vasantha Madhusudana more audibly than the commotion caused by the group of bees. Thus that tree which was surrounded by many birds looked splendid like the sage Shukacharya and the parrot in that garden.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: षट्-अङ्घ्रि-संघ-आरव-कैतवेन गायन् मुदा माधव-कीर्तिम् उच्चैः द्विज-प्रवेकैः अरुचत् प्रवीतः शुकः यथा तत्र हि किंशुक-द्रुः
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: तत्र षडङ्घ्रिसंघारवकैतवेन मुदा उच्चैः माधवकीर्तिम् गायन् द्विजप्रवेकैः प्रवीतः किंशुकद्रुः शुकः यथा हि अरुचत् ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Surrounded by choice birds, the Kimshuka tree shone resplendently like Sage Shuka surrounded by noble Brahmins, as if joyfully singing aloud the praises of Lord Madhava (and the spring) under the pretext of the humming swarms of bees.

42.sa: किंशुकः कुसुममालया वने फुल्लया च नितरां विदिद्युते । दानवारिमसुरान्त्रमालया मण्डितं खलु विडम्बयन्निव ॥ ४२ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: The Kimshuka tree adorned with bunches of blooming flowers shone splendidly in that garden as though it was imitating Lord Sri Narasimha decorated with the garland of intestines of that demon Hiranyakashipu whom he had killed. Or it can also be said that it appeared as though it was deriding the Lord.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: किंशुकः कुसुममालया वने फुल्लया च नितराम् विदिद्युते दानवारिम् असुर-अन्त्र-मालया मण्डितम् खलु विडम्बयन् इव
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: वने फुल्लया कुसुममालया किंशुकः च असुरान्त्रमालया मण्डितं दानवारिं विडम्बयन् इव नितरां विदिद्युते खलु ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Adorned with clusters of bright, blossoming flowers in the forest, the Kimshuka tree shone exceedingly bright, as though it were imitating Lord Narasimha wearing a garland of the demon's entrails.

43.sa: स इत्थमालोक्य वनं गतानां विलासिनीनां विहृतिप्रभेदान् । उपेन्द्रवज्रायितकायसारो गृहं प्रविश्याब्दगणान्मुमोद ॥ ४३ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: Thus Venkatanathacharya, whose sturdy physical frame resembled Vajrayudha, the weapon of Devendra reached his village after watching different games played by those wanton women in the garden on his way back. Thereafter he led his life happily with his wife for many years in his house. As Venkatanathacharya's mind and body were as strong as Devendra's Vajrayudha, his act of witnessing different games of those coquettish girls did not arouse any feelings of perturbation either in his mind or his body.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: सः इत्थम् आलोक्य वनम् गतानाम् विलासिनीनाम् विहृति-प्रभेदान् उपेन्द्रवज्रायित-काय-सारः गृहम् प्रविश्य अब्द-गणान् मुमोद
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: उपेन्द्रवज्रायितकायसारः सः इत्थम् वनम् गतानाम् विलासिनीनाम् विहृतिप्रभेदान् आलोक्य गृहम् प्रविश्य अब्दगणान् मुमोद ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: Having witnessed the various sports and pastimes of the charming women in the grove without being perturbed, Venkatanatha, whose body and resolve were as firm as a thunderbolt, returned home and spent many years in happiness.

44.sa: श्रीमत्कश्यपवंशवार्धिशशिनः षड्दर्शनीवल्लभ- श्रीलक्ष्मीनरसिंहवित्तविदुषः श्रीवेङ्कटाम्बामणौ । जातेनार्यदयासुधामयगिरा नारायणेनोदिते काव्ये चारुणि राघवेन्द्रविजये सर्गोऽभवत्पञ्चमः ॥ ४४ ॥

commentaries.pavamanacharya_english: Thus concludes the fifth canto of the epic "Sri Raghavendravijaya" enchanting with ambrosial words composed by Narayanacharya with the blessings of his father. Narayanacharya who had his education from his father was the son of the couple Venkatamba and Lakshminarasimhacharya who was an erudite scholar in all the six Shastras and who was born and shone like a moon in the ocean of Kashyapagothra named after that virtuous and scholarly sage Kashyapa.
commentaries.gemini_padaccheda: श्रीमत्-कश्यप-वंश-वार्धि-शशिनः षड्दर्शनी-वल्लभ-श्री-लक्ष्मीनरसिंह-वित्त-विदुषः श्री-वेङ्कटाम्बा-मणौ जातेन आर्य-दया-सुधा-मय-गिरा नारायणेन उदिते काव्ये चारुणि राघवेन्द्रविजये सर्गः अभवत् पञ्चमः
commentaries.gemini_anvaya: श्रीमत्-कश्यप-वंश-वार्धि-शशिनः षड्दर्शनी-वल्लभ-श्री-लक्ष्मीनरसिंह-वित्त-विदुषः (सकाशात्) श्री-वेङ्कटाम्बा-मणौ जातेन आर्य-दया-सुधा-मय-गिरा नारायणेन उदिते चारुणि राघवेन्द्रविजये काव्ये पञ्चमः सर्गः अभवत् ।
commentaries.gemini_summary: This marks the conclusion of the fifth canto of the delightful poem 'Raghavendra Vijaya', composed with nectar-like speech bestowed by the grace of his venerable father by Narayanacharya, the son born to Venkatamba and Lakshminarasimhacharya, who was a master of the six philosophical systems and the moon to the ocean of the Kashyapa lineage.
